trigger.description: Start this workflow whenever a new item appears in an RSS, Atom or JSON feed: a blog post, a news story, a podcast episode, a video or a release. Each new item starts its own run, with the item's title, link, author, date, summary and content.
trigger.name: trigger

parameters.description: The address of the RSS, Atom or JSON feed to watch, e.g. https://example.com/feed.xml. Use the feed's own address, not the website's home page.
parameters.name: feed_url

parameters.description: Only start a run for items whose title, summary, content or author mention this word or phrase. Capitals are ignored.
parameters.name: contains

trigger.result_str_template: Started by a new feed item.

returns.description: The new item. Dates are in UTC (e.g. 2026-10-13T09:30:00Z); 'content' is the item's body as plain text and 'content_html' the same body as HTML. An item whose feed gives no date, author or image has that field empty.

examples.author: Ana Lima
examples.content: Today we are opening the beta to everyone on the waitlist. …
examples.content_html: Today we are opening the beta to everyone on the waitlist.
examples.summary: Today we are opening the beta to everyone on the waitlist.
examples.title: Launch day

description: Start workflows when a feed publishes something new.
